final_topology.title: Hierarchical Network Architecture
final_topology.description: A secure hierarchical network design for a government entity, including an Internet Edge, a three-tier data center, and WAN connectivity for remote sites.
final_topology.topology_summary: The topology includes an Internet Edge zone with a firewall and application-layer security, a three-tier data center, and WAN connections to regional and branch offices. Remote sites have local routing and switching.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Asset Management' zone with an 'Asset Inventory System' node, which suggests the presence of an asset management system.

controls.title: Document Data Flows
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Data Flow Documentation' zone with a 'Data Flow Documentation Management Service' node, indicating that data flow documentation is managed.

controls.title: Segment Data Processing and Storage Based on Sensitivity
controls.evidence: The topology includes multiple zones (e.g., 'Data Center', 'Non-Production Zone', 'Management Zone') that suggest segmentation based on data sensitivity.

controls.title: Implement and Manage a Firewall on Servers
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Firewall' node in the 'Internet Edge' zone, which is connected to various other zones, suggesting that firewalls are implemented and managed.

controls.title: Configure Trusted DNS Servers on Enterprise Assets
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'DNS Server' node in the 'Internet Edge' zone, which is connected to the firewall, suggesting that trusted DNS servers are configured.

controls.title: Require MFA for Remote Network Access
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Remote Access VPN Gateway' node and an 'MFA/Identity Node' in the 'Internet Edge' zone, both of which are connected to the identity server, suggesting that MFA is required for remote access.

controls.title: Use DNS Filtering Services
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'DNS Filtering Node' in the 'Internet Edge' zone, which is connected to the firewall, suggesting that DNS filtering services are used.

controls.title: Maintain and Enforce Network-Based URL Filters
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Web Proxy' and an 'Application Firewall' in the 'Internet Edge' zone, both of which are connected to the firewall, suggesting that network-based URL filters are maintained and enforced.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain a Secure Network Architecture
controls.evidence: The topology includes multiple zones and nodes that suggest a secure network architecture, including segmentation, least privilege, and availability.

controls.title: Securely Manage Network Infrastructure
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'IaC Tools' zone with an 'IaC Tools Management Service' node, suggesting that network infrastructure is securely managed using IaC.

controls.title: Centralize Network Authentication, Authorization, and Auditing (AAA)
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Identity Server' and an 'MFA/Identity Node' in the 'Management Zone', both of which are connected to the remote access VPN gateway, suggesting centralized AAA.

controls.title: Ensure Remote Devices Utilize a VPN and are Connecting to an Enterprise’s AAA Infrastructure
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Remote Access VPN Gateway' node in the 'Internet Edge' zone, which is connected to the identity server and MFA/identity node, suggesting that remote devices utilize a VPN and connect to the AAA infrastructure.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain Dedicated Computing Resources for All Administrative Work
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Dedicated Admin Workstation' node in the 'Management Zone', which is connected to the identity server, suggesting dedicated computing resources for administrative work.

controls.title: Deploy a Network Intrusion Detection Solution
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'IDS/IPS' node in the 'Internet Edge' zone, which is connected to the firewall and SIEM, suggesting that a network intrusion detection solution is deployed.

controls.title: Perform Traffic Filtering Between Network Segments
controls.evidence: The topology includes multiple zones and links between them, suggesting that traffic filtering is performed between network segments.

controls.title: Manage Access Control for Remote Assets
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Remote Access VPN Gateway' node and an 'MFA/Identity Node' in the 'Internet Edge' zone, both of which are connected to the identity server, suggesting that access control for remote assets is managed.

controls.title: Collect Network Traffic Flow Logs
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'SIEM' node in the 'Internet Edge' zone, which is connected to the IDS/IPS, suggesting that network traffic flow logs are collected.

controls.title: Deploy a Network Intrusion Prevention Solution
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'IDS/IPS' node in the 'Internet Edge' zone, which is connected to the firewall and SIEM, suggesting that a network intrusion prevention solution is deployed.

controls.title: Deploy Port-Level Access Control
controls.evidence: The topology includes an '802.1X Controller' node in the 'Internet Edge' zone, which is connected to the firewall, suggesting that port-level access control is deployed.

controls.title: Perform Application Layer Filtering
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Application Layer Security Appliance' and an 'Application Firewall' in the 'Internet Edge' zone, both of which are connected to the firewall, suggesting that application layer filtering is performed.

controls.title: Separate Production and Non-Production Systems
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Non-Production Zone' that is separated from the 'Data Center', suggesting that production and non-production systems are separated.

controls.title: Perform Periodic External Penetration Tests
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'External Testing Zone' with a 'Penetration Testing Node', suggesting that periodic external penetration tests are performed.
